s: Din maboy shennipratz ubo y' seipim: maboy shennipratz echad mitztzedadayv lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit, ap al pi shello nipratz bemilluo vegam en bappirtza yoter meeser, im hi bepachot mid' tepachim lerosho hammetuqqan belechi o qora, dehaynu shello nishar omed d' tepachim bekotel hammaboy shebbesiyyum happirtza, vehi yetera mig' tepachim, sheenah kelabud — asur, shemma yannichu bene hammaboy petach hammaboy hammetuqqan belechi veqora, veyeleku lahem derek pirtza zo lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit shehammaboy nipratz lahen kede leqatztzer darkam, veyitbattel mimmennu shem petach maboy, kevan sheen bene hammaboy holekim sham. Veyitbattelu gam ken hallechi vehaqqora shebbo, lepi shehem tzerikim lihyot bepetach hammaboy, vehu en shem petach maboy alayv. Abal keshennishar pas d' tepachim omed mehakkotel — lo nitbattel shem petach maboy mimmennu, lepi shehu adayin patuach led' tepachim hallalu, sheyyesh shem maboy alehem. Shello ameru "shiur maboy d' ammot" ella habba laasot heksher maboy battechilla, abal maboy shehaya kasher mittechillato, eno nipsal umitbattel mittorat maboy ad shello nishtayyer bo d' tepachim. Lepikak im lo nishtayyer omed d' tepachim, verotzeh lehaamid sham pas d' tepachim — eno moil kelum ad sheyyehe bappas d' ammot, kevan shekkebar nipsal hammaboy uba lehakshiro. Vekevan sheyyesh shem maboy al d' tepachim shennishtayyeru, o al d' ammot sheheemid — hare hallechi o haqqora metuqqanim lepetach maboy karauy, vehappirtza enah oseret kelal im enah yetera meeser ammot, shehi kepetach gam ken, veen hammaboy nipsal biptachim harbeh. Vehu sheen rabbim boqeim bepirtza zo, kegon shepperutza lemaqom metunnap o mequlqal betit, veen derek rabbim laabor beotah pirtza, vekol shekken im nishtayyeru giddudim mehakkotel shennipratz, shehem meakkebim hahilluk. Abal im rabbim boqeim sham, apillu en sham bappirtza ella d' tepachim — tzarik letaqqenah (betzurat petach kedin maboy mepullash, shehare maboy zeh mepullash hu mippetach zeh lepetach haggadol shebbo hallechi o haqqora):

Umeboot shellanu, ap al pi sheddinam kechatzer sheenah nitteret belechi veqora, ubechatzer en pirtza oseret ap al pi sherabbim boqeim bah, ella im ken yetera meeser — ap al pi ken yesh lehachamir bezeh bimboot shellanu sheyyesh bahem pirtza d' tepachim verabbim boqeim bah, laasot sham tiqqun. Veken ir hammuqqepet choma shennipretza pirtza d' tepachim bechomatah, verabbim boqeim sham — yesh lehachamir laasot sham tiqqun (ap al pi sheen bair maboy shebbattim vachatzerot petuchim letoko karauy. Abal im yesh bair maboy shebbattim vachatzerot petuchim letoko karauy — min haddin tzarik laasot tiqqun lepirtzat chomatah o lemaboy hahu):

Maboy shennipratz bemilluo lechatzer, venipretza hechatzer mitztzad hashsheni lirshut harabbim, velo erebu bene hechatzer im hammaboy — chatzer mutteret. Apillu pirtza shel reshut harabbim hi keneged happirtza shel maboy, veharabbim niknasin bezo veyotzein bezo — en beqiat harabbim oseret bechatzer, raq shello yihyu happeratzot yeterot meeser. Umippene shello ereba im hammaboy — enah neeseret, sheen hammaboy oser al chatzerot happetuchot lo, ella hachatzerot hen sheoserim alayv keshergilot bo, shedderisat raglehen alayv. Vehammaboy asur, shehechatzer oseret alayv, kevan shello ereba immo. Veap al pi sheenah regila bo, shehare akshav hu shennipratz lah, mikkol maqom kevan shennipratz bemilluo lemaqom haasur lo beli erub — neesar kullo. Mah sheen ken hechatzer enah perutza lo bemilluah, ella nisharu bo gippupin mikkan umikkan odepim al hammaboy, shehi rechaba mimmennu. Ukegon shekkotle orek hammaboy niknasin betok hechatzer umuplagin sham mikkotle orek hechatzer g' tepachim, sheim lo ken hare gippupe hechatzer moilim gam lammaboy mishshum nireh mibbechutz veshaveh mibbipnim, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"s, veeno qaruy parutz bemilluo veen hechatzer oseret alayv ap im hi regila bo. Veap shekkol chatzer haregila bemaboy oseret alayv keshello ereba immo, ap al pi shello nipratz lah hammaboy kelal ella hi petucha lo bepetach gamur, mikkol maqom chatzer zo, kevan sheyyesh lah derek acheret lelek bah lirshut harabbim shello derek hammaboy, dehaynu derek pirtzatah shennipretza lirshut harabbim — kopin ota al middat sedom, shello taabor beshabbat derek hammaboy veteesor alayv:

Veim erebu bene hechatzer im bene hammaboy, upirtzat hechatzer shellirshut harabbim o lekarmelit enah mekuvvenet keneged pirtzat hammaboy lechatzer — gam hammaboy muttar. Abal im happeratzot hem mekuvvanot zo keneged zo — hare zeh nireh keillu hammaboy hu mepullash lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit shekkenegdo, vetzarik letaqqeno sham betzurat petach etzel pirtzato. Vaapillu kesheen happeratzot mekuvvanot, eno muttar ella kesheppirtzato lechatzer hi beemtza rochab hechatzer, velo mitztzad rochbah samuk lekotel orkah, shekkevan sherochbah shel chatzer odep al hammaboy mikkal tzad — nireh shehammaboy lechatzer hu kaleh veeno moshek ad reshut harabbim o karmelit shekkenegdo, veeno kimpullash. Abal im pirtzato lechatzer hi mitztzad hechatzer, shekkotel orek hammaboy shaveh leechad mikkotle orek hechatzer — hare zeh nireh kemaboy arok ad kotel shekkenegdo, umashuk sham beaqmumit ad reshut harabbim o karmelit, vahare hu nireh kemaboy mepullash beaqmumit. Vaapillu im pirtzato leemtza hechatzer, eno muttar ella keshehechatzer hi shel rabbim. Abal bechatzer shel yachid — chosheshin shemma yimmalek veyibneh battim bachatzero berochab haodep al hammaboy, utehe pirtzat hammaboy mitztzad hechatzer, vitaltelu bo kebattechilla:

Veim nipratz lirchaba sheachore habbattim sheenah yetera mibbet satayim, o yetera mibbet satayim vehuqqepa ledira — dino keillu nipratz lechatzer. Abal im yetera al bet satayim velo huqqepa ledira — dino kenipratz lekarmelit, vetzarik sham tiqqun bekol inyan. Veim tzad hashsheni shel harechaba patuach lishbil sheyyesh lo mechitztza mikkan umikkan veoleh ad sepat hannahar, vederek harechaba vehashshebil molikin bene hammaboy et behemtam lannahar lehashqotam — yaasu lechi berosh zeh shel hammaboy shenniptach larechaba vetzurat petach berosh hashsheni happatuach lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit, veal yede lechi zeh naaset harechaba muqqepet ledira, shehallechi niddon mishshum mechitztza ukeillu asa mechitztza leharechaba lehaqqipah ledira, dehaynu lehishtammesh bah mehammaboy derek petach zeh shenniptach lah hammaboy, sheppetach nechshab kedira, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"ch. Veap al pi shellechi eno moil lehaqqip ledira, vaapillu tzurat petach vaapillu mechitztza gemura enan moilin im enan yeterim meeser, kemo shennitbaer sham — mikkol maqom kan, mittok shehallechi hazzeh moil lehammaboy lehakshiro, moil gam ken leharechaba lehaqqipah ledira ulehattir letaltel bah. Umuttar letaltel gam ken mittokah lammaboy umimmaboy letokah, sheen harechaba oseret al hammaboy beli erub, lepi sheen bah diyyurin. Abal bishbil — asur letaltel bo ella bed' ammot im en bispat hannahar gobah y' tepachim shettehe nechshebet mechitztza lo, veken omeq hannahar shelletzad hashshebil eno mitlaqqet asara mittok d' ammot. Apillu im meeber hannahar yesh sham giddudim gebohim asara, veen eser ammot berochab hannahar hammapsiq ben hashshebil lehaggiddudim, ap al pi ken enan olin lo limchitztza, gezera shemma yabou lehattir shebil acher sheen sham giddudim kelal, mippene shello yaaleh al datam kelal sheshshebil zeh nittar begiddudim shemmeeber hannahar. Abal nahar hamhallek samuk lemaboy veen bispato gobah y' tepachim, vegam omqo shelletzad hammaboy eno mitlaqqet asara mittok d' ammot, ella shemmeeber hannahar yesh sham giddudim gebohim y', o sheomeq hannahar atzmo shebbetzad hashsheni mitlaqqet asara mittok d' ammot — yesh lehistappeq im olim lemaboy limchitztza rebiit, ki shemma lo gazeru gezera zo ella bishbil, sheen bene adam metzuyim bo kol kak. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen yoter meeser ammot rochab missepat hammaboy ad maqom hammitlaqqet o ad haggiddudim. Abal im yesh sham yoter meeser ammot — en lehistappeq kelal, sheenam moilim kelum lammaboy, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"g:

Muttar lehishtammesh bepetach hammaboy keneged hallechi, lepi sheap shechuddo happenimi hu shessotem kimchitztza, mikkol maqom kevan sheen berochab maqom zeh d' tepachim — meqom petur hu. Veken muttar lehishtammesh tachat haqqora, lepi sheap shehaqqora hi mishshum hekker libne hammaboy, ubechuddo happenimi hu sheyyesh lahem hekker, mikkol maqom kevan sheen berochab maqom zeh shettachteha d' tepachim — meqom petur hu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemaboy happatuach lirshut harabbim. Abal bepatuach lekarmelit asur lehishtammesh, ben keneged hallechi ben tachat haqqora, lepi shemmaqom zeh sheen bo d' mitztarep hu lehakkarmelit venaaseh kamoha, shemmatza min et mino veneor, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h. Veap hacholeqim sham modim kan, hoil veen begobah maqom g' tepachim. Veim haqqora rechaba d' tepachim uberia leqabbel maaziba — hare shem tiqra aleha, veomerim "pi tiqra hachitzon yored vesotem", [umuttar] lehishtammesh tachteha ap al pi sheppatuach hammaboy lekarmelit:

Ap al pi shemmuttar lehishtammesh keneged hallechi o tachat haqqora, lo yesheb adam bepetach hammaboy vechepetz beyado, shemma yitgalgel hachepetz lirshut harabbim veyishkach vibiennu, kevan sheen hekker beno lirshut harabbim. Abal bepetach hechatzer, ben sheppatuach lirshut harabbim ben sheppatuach lekarmelit — muttar, lepi sheyyesh hekker. Vehu haddin bepetach maboy hammetuqqan betzurat petach. Umikkol maqom betzurat petach shellanu, shehu gaboah meod, yesh lehachamir apillu bepatuach lekarmelit:
Nashim hayyoshebot al petach hammaboy vekaddehen beyadan — en memachin beyadan, lepi shebbevadday lo yishmeu lanu, umutab sheyyihyu shogegot veal yihyu mezidot:

Maboy shennapelu lechyo o qorato beshabbat, ap al pi shehuttar kebar lemiqtzat shabbat — asur mishsham veelak. Veen omerim bo "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", kevan shehu patuach lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b. Abal ir hammuqqepet choma, venapal hattiqqun shebbammaboy beshabbat — huttar lekol shabbat zo, shehare hachoma mapseqet beno lirshut harabbim o karmelit shechutz lair, vekol hair hi reshut hayyachid gemura min hattora, ella shechasera erub, sheddirat hannokrim mebattelet erub hayyisreelim keshennapal tiqqun hammapsiq benehem, ubezeh omerim "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", kemo shennitbaer sham. Veim sapeq ematay napal, im beshabbat im mibbeod yom — holekim lehaqel, shessepeq dibre soperim hu. Vekol zeh keshehaya hattiqqun rauy laamod kol hashshabbat. Abal im meereb shabbat haya omed lissater beshabbat, kegon bimqomot shemmetzuyim nokrim shemmeqalqelim otam belel shabbat, veqarob levadday hu sheyyeqalqeluhu — asur leachar shennistar:

Maboy sheerebu bo kol chatzerotayv erub echad beyachad, vehu hanniqra "shittupe meboot", venishbera haqqora, veneesar hammaboy betiltul mittoko lachatzerot umechatzerot letoko — hare oto hechatzer shehashshittup munnach bah, veken chatzerot happetuchim lah, muttarot betiltul mittokan umizzo lezo. Ap al pi sheyyesh diyyurin harbeh bekol achat mehen velo erebu benehen erub acher millebad hashshittup, hare somekin al hashshittup bimqom erub, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shp"z. Abal chatzerot sheenan petuchot lechatzer shehashshittup munnach bah, apillu hen omedot betziddah, raq sheen lah mehen petach o challon shehu betok y' tepachim — asurot, shehare en hashshittup etzlan, veenan yekolot lehabi oto etzlan derek hammaboy, kevan shennishbera haqqora. Vehu shennishbera mibbeod yom. Abal im nishbera beshabbat — omerim "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera". Ukeshehu beinyan shehen asurot, asur letaltel bahen apillu bebayit echad mecheder lecheder im bekol cheder dar adam echad bipne atzmo, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"a. Vetzarik lehazhir al zeh bimqomot sheen lahem lechi o qora. (Vegam tzarik lehazhiram shello yaasu erube chatzerot bappesach bebet hakkeneset ella im ken yesh b' battim bachatzar bet hakkeneset o bechatzer hassemuka lebet hakkeneset, beinyan sheyyukelu lehabi haerub etzlam derek petach o challon beshabbat). Vegam bimqomot sheyyesh sham lechi o qora o tzurat petach venishbar hattiqqun beoto maboy shel bet hakkeneset, im nishbar bechol — kol hammeboot asurim, apillu yesh lahem tiqqun bipne atzmo, ella im ken hu beinyan sheyyekolin lehabi etzlam haerub mibbet hakkeneset:
